title: Titanium Smartphone SIM Tray
alloyReason: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V (Grade 5, UNS R56400) was selected for this phone hardware application because its 900+ MPa tensile enables thin-wall lightweighting under cyclic loading. The alpha-beta microstructure provides 45% higher specific strength than 4140 steel, critical for weight-sensitive designs. Its 6.7 W/mK thermal conductivity simplifies thermal management. This rationale is driven by smartphone sim card / nvme tray and fat life requirements.
process: CNC milling HSM 30k RPM for phone hardware geometry

commonFailures: Anodic color shift DE >2.0 from inconsistent bath temp - requires ±1C electrolyte control during PVD — critical for smartphone sim card performance

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Smartphone SIM Tray suitable for Smartphone SIM card / NVMe tray?
faq.a: Titanium Smartphone SIM Tray uses Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address phone hardware operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Smartphone SIM Tray?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Smartphone SIM Tray is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for smartphone sim card requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Smartphone SIM Tray require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. smartphone sim card components require PVD TiAlN coating (2-3um, HV2500 hardness) for scratch resistance and uniform gunmetal aesthetic finish — tailored for smartphone sim card application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Smartphone SIM Tray shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment of Titanium Smartphone SIM Tray includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance confirming all processes meet smartphone sim card specifications; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements on critical features; (4) Surface roughness certification per applicable standards. FAIR available on request.
